english.title: Cause / permit goods vehicle to be taken outside UK in breach of prohibition notice
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without reasonable excuse,

(A)_[caused]_
(B)_[permitted]_

a goods vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE..), to be taken from the United Kingdom to another country, namely **(..SPECIFY COUNTRY..), contrary to a prohibition notice issued by an examiner, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), under section 7 of the Haulage Permits and Trailer Registration Act 2018
english.legislation: Contrary to section 8(4)(b) and (5) of the Haulage Permits and Trailer Registration Act 2018.

english.notes: For the purposes of this offence, an examiner means an examiner appointed under section 66A of the Road Traffic Act 1988 or Article 74 of the Road Traffic (Northern Ireland) Order 1995.
